$comment: Provenance for the vendored magnetite game module beside it. Its absence for the previous vendor (e4a7a1d, unrecorded) is why a driver and a module silently disagreed for months. Re-verify with: shasum -a 256 public/magnetite/arena-authority.wasm dist/magnetite/arena-authority.wasm dist-demo/magnetite/arena-authority.wasm site/play/magnetite/arena-authority.wasm — all four must match this file's sha256.
source_commit_note: magnetite main HEAD at build time. The ABI fix landed earlier in this history at 9c244934837650d7834d50d6f703808c9f886f2e ('abi: mag_* seven bug fixes, mag_abi_version, tick in mag_step, bare-JSON mag_restore, doc audit') and is an ancestor of d9efd45.
build_command: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm  (run from game-templates/authoritative)
mag_abi_version_verified_by: calling the instantiated module's mag_abi_version() export directly in Node before vendoring; returned 1
wasm_module_imports_note: WebAssembly.Module.imports() is empty — instantiates under a plain WebAssembly.instantiate(bytes, {}) with no host functions, matching packages/wibbly-authority's requirement.

previous_vendor.source_commit: unrecorded — only ever touched by e4a7a1d ('feat: wibbly now runs a real magnetite authority in the browser'), never updated since
previous_vendor.status: STALE as of this re-vendor. Predated: mag_abi_version (did not exist), 7 mag_* ABI bug fixes, the input-discarding-on-malformed-payload defect, the on_join-never-called defect, and the per-tick RNG derivation. Confirmed identical to the wasm32-unknown-unknown build already sitting in magnetite's own target/ directory from a 2026-07-21 build, which is how the sha256 above was cross-checked.

abi_break_from_previous_vendor: mag_step payload changed from a bare JSON array of [player_id, input] pairs to {"tick": N, "inputs": [...]}; the driver must send the wrapping object and a strictly-increasing tick
mag_step reply gained a "tick" field echoing the tick simulated (additive; no driver change required)
mag_restore framing is UNCHANGED — bare JSON, no length prefix on the way in. wibbly's driver already did this correctly; the host side was what had been wrong
mag_abi_version() is a new required export; the host must call it and refuse a module that does not report 1
how_to_reproduce: cd magnetite && git checkout d9efd454ac61d114e985bec91ac91b9228a5e716 -- game-templates/authoritative backend/magnetite-sdk
cd game-templates/authoritative && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm
